fullContentHtml:
RSSB CET 10+2 Inter Level Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB) has released the notification for the post of Common Eligibility Test (CET Inter Level ) 10+2 Level Examination 2026. The online application process for RSSB CET 10+2 Inter Level Recruitment 2026 has started on 24 June 2026, and candidates can apply till 23 July 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for RSSB CET 10+2 Inter Level Recruitment 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 24 June 2026
  • Last Date : 23 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 23 July 2026
  • Exam Date : 23-25 October 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, Other State Rs. : 600/-
  • OBC (NCL), MBC of Rajasthan : Rs. 400/-
  • All PH Candidates : Rs. 400/-
  • SC/  ST Candidates : Rs. 400/- (Earning Less Than 2.5 Lakhs Yearly)
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is RSSB CET 10+2 Inter Level Online Form 2026?

RSSB CET 10+2 Inter Level Online Form 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

The last date to apply is 23 July 2026.

The official website is: https://rssb.rajasthan.gov.in/

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
